name: Inset text
summary: Use inset text to distinguish a short block of supporting information from the content around it.
whenToUse: Use for important supplementary information that users should notice but that is not a warning or success state.
Use for a short block that benefits from visual separation within the flow of the page.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for warnings about serious consequences; use Warning text.
Do not use for successful completion; use a Panel where appropriate.
Do not place most of a page inside inset text.

anatomy.name: Inset container
anatomy.description: A govuk-inset-text container provides the reviewed left border and spacing.

anatomy.name: Supporting content
anatomy.description: Concise text or simple semantic content explains the supporting point.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: A short supporting block on the standard page background.

behaviour: The component has no JavaScript behaviour and remains ordinary document content without CSS.
Keep it in the reading order at the point where its information is relevant.
accessibility: The left border is decorative; the wording must carry the full meaning.
Add semantic headings, lists or links inside only when the content requires them.
Do not use colour or placement alone to indicate urgency.
content: Keep the message concise and directly related to the surrounding task.
Use ordinary sentence case and avoid a heading unless it helps users scan a longer inset.

htmlExamples.name: Processing-time information
htmlExamples.html: It can take up to 8 weeks to register a lasting power of attorney.
